title: Young Girls Swimming in Harbor, 1970 Balboa B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage square black and white snapshot photo from October 1970 featuring two young girls, Laurel and Mary Lou Reinhart, swimming with inflatable water floats in a calm bay or harbor. Several motorboats and a small sailboat are visible in the background, offering a glimpse into American outdoor summer leisure during the early 1970s.
